text: にもつ　いっぱいで　もてへんよ

structure.jp: にもつ　いっぱいで

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: もつ 'carry' changed to もてる means 'can carry'. へん is the Kansai dialect way of saying ない, 'not'. もてへん = 'can't carry'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で here gives the reason for what comes next. いっぱいで = 'it's full, so'.
